title: Eight Trigrams Thirty-Two Palms
body:
Syntax: perform eight trigrams thirty-two palms [target]

Minimum level 60, Byakugan mastery 12% and inherited Potential 0 or higher. This is a clan-exclusive Gentle Fist technique, dealing damage to the opponent and targeting chakra/stamina pathways. Successful hits may seal tenketsu briefly, stopping jutsu use. See 'help hyuga' for full bloodline rules. A technique only becomes available when level, mastery, and the character's permanent bloodline potential all qualify.
